commit_message: Complete ADR0126 schema and Event crossing semantics
pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR0126 Timeline and Sequencer
pr_body:
## Summary

Continues ADR0126 first-release completion. The Timeline schema is tightened to the six first-release track families; Animation clips persist stable Animation Set + MotionSlotId identity; Transform/Property clips use validated multi-key typed curves and a shared deterministic sampler; Event/marker payloads are bounded; and Event-track clips compile as exact side-effect points with crossing and scrub-preview semantics.

The PR remains Draft while production runtime composition, Project Rust integration, the dedicated Sequencer workspace, and required Windows/Visual Validation continue.
